spans.s: रेक, रेच, रेचित, &c. See p. 852, col. 3.

1. रेक, अस्, m. suspicion, doubt, fear, care, anxiety,
concern; a man of a low caste, outcast; a frog; [cf.
भेक.]

रेक 2. रेक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रिच्), emptying,
loosening, looseness, purging.

रेक् रेक्, cl. 1. A. रेकते, रिरेके, रेकितुम्,
to suspect, doubt.

रेकु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. empty, void, deserted,
solitary, lonely, secret.
